text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—I had a wonderful run! Just as you said, 
Trainer, it looks like I can really shine 
in sprints!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Both Bakushin O-san and Zephyr-san 
recognized me as a rival... I'm so excited 
to run with them again♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer and I had a great talk about 
taking on another GⅠ, the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen... It feels like both of us have 
grown a lot bigger since before♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
An even more wonderful future awaits just 
ahead! I had this feeling of absolute 
happiness coming our way...
